title: Cloud & Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud & Network Infrastructure Engineer


Offers 24x7 software-defined infrastructure and cloud connectivity solutions and compute, storage, and networking including Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) and Azure Landing Zones, facilitating secure and automated cloud adoption.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain software-defined networking using Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI).
  • Design and manage Azure Landing Zones to support secure, standardized cloud adoption.
  • Provide 24x7 support for compute, storage, and networking infrastructure.
  • Support automated provisioning of cloud infrastructure through Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Ensure network and cloud connectivity security, segmentation, and compliance.
  • Monitor infrastructure performance and proactively address capacity or connectivity issues.
  • Collaborate with application and platform teams on cloud migration and adoption strategies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to network and cloud infrastructure.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience with Cisco ACI or comparable software-defined networking solutions.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing Azure Landing Zones.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, security groups, and connectivity models.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code for cloud provisioning (e.g. Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates).
  • Knowledge of hybrid cloud and on-premise integration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills in a 24x7 operational environment.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to be part of a global organization.
  • Encouraging working atmosphere, engaging activities, and extra benefits (e.g. additional medical insurance (covers gym subscription), team events, outreach activities, and others);
  • Hybrid work model with remote work opportunities ( 3/5 days weekly from the office)
  • Open, modern, and ergonomic work environment when working from the office with the multicultural community.

  • Opportunity to grow professionally and personally (e.g. Udemy) and continuously develop within the domain.
    The salary range for this position is from 4.485 to 5.950 EURO gross before taxes.*
    *Salary offer for the candidate is determined based on the predefined salary ranges for the position and depends on the level of competence and experience of the candidate.

title: Video Content Moderator with Greek
description:
Working hours: 3PM-11PM (main shift), including weekend shifts.

Readiness, depending on business needs, to work on a 24/7 basis (morning, afternoon or night shifts).

WORK FROM THE OFFICE

Are you a fan of vlogging or constantly looking to videos to help solve your challenges? Do you want to learn more about social media regulation, online free speech, internal controls or maybe even learn about EU policy making?

If the answer is yes, then we have an amazing opportunity for you as a Video Content Moderator.

Join our team for the world’s best loved video-sharing website!

Requirements:

  • Proficiency of Greek on at least C1 level and English at B2 level,

  • Willingness to work from the office,
  • Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills,
  • Quick learner and adaptable to learn new processes, concepts, and skills,
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills,
  • Strong attention to detail and a desire to deliver accurately, efficiently, and to a high standard,
  • Having a neutral mindset to alternative video content that needs classification.

Accountabilities:

  • Revision of user reports regarding website content,
  • Analysis and identification of content according to compliance policies,
  • Making well-balanced decisions and helping to resolve inquiries to defined policies and procedures by flagging discrepancies,
  • Using market specific knowledge and insights to improve the support of user community,
  • Revision of sensitive content, sometimes involving graphic or disturbing subject matter.

Benefits:

  • Extensive benefits package: Multisport Card, LuxMed medical healthcare including dental care, life insurance, cafeteria benefits,

  • Open-minded and multinational environment,
  • Opportunity to be part of a global organization focused on development,
  • Professional development and clear career path,
  • Training & development opportunities including language courses.

Content Moderators play an important role in ensuring the safety of online communities against harmful user generated content. Safeguarding the online communication space can lead to meaningful and rewarding work for a content moderator as the mission of moderation aims to create positive, safe and inclusive environments for everyone.

Rewarding outcomes are not often without challenges. As a part of the job requirement, you will be required to review and analyze explicit and extremely sensitive content sometimes involving graphic or otherwise disturbing text, videos, and images which may be disturbing due to their egregious nature. The content under review is likely to expose the reviewer to crime scenes, dangerous or derogatory content, abuse, harassment and sexually explicit content.

At Cognizant, we are committed to the safety and well-being of our employees. As part of our benefits, we proactively provide evidence-based wellbeing solutions for employees working within the critical role of content moderation. Our wellness practices are holistic and aimed at risk mitigation across areas of training, monitoring and support. We understand the cost of caring and the importance of creating a resilient workforce in which employees thrive while being able to make a difference in the world around them.

We can't wait for you to join our team!

FRESH GRADUATES ARE WELCOME!


For more information about us, visit Cognizant Poland.

Stay up to date with our recent events – follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Healthcare Consultant - Business Transformation
description:
The Company

Cognizant is a leading provider of information technology, consulting, and business process outsourcing services, dedicated to helping the world's leading companies build stronger businesses. Headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey (U.S.), Cognizant has over 340,000 employees as of January 2025.

About Cognizant Consulting

To be digital, companies today must have organizational velocity approaching speed of light while providing individualized offerings that result in fanatical levels of customer satisfaction—all with laser-focused cost control. And from applications to infrastructure, processes to operational models and interfaces to experiences—there are digital forces driving change in every part of our clients’ organization. At Cognizant, our consultants orchestrate the capabilities to truly change the game—across strategy, design, technology and industry/functional knowledge to deliver insight at speed and solutions at scale. Our approach is built around elevating business understanding of the aspirations and unique abilities of customers and employees and by building these relationships based on trust and value.

More information? Please visit https://www.cognizant.com/consulting

Domain - Health care

Join Cognizant's Healthcare Consulting team and help shape the future of healthcare through digital transformation and innovation. We are looking for professionals with experience in public sector healthcare organizations, digital maturity assessments, and large-scale transformation programme delivery. Collaborate with healthcare providers, payers, and government agencies to improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency. Drive strategic initiatives that accelerate healthcare modernization and technology adoption.

Job Summary

As our Senior Manager in Public Sector Consulting you'll lead sales delivery and relationship management across our health care consulting team You'll be a front facing leader who can shape opportunities create practical proposals and then deliver programmes of work end-end supporting operational performance enhancement strategy and planning and digitally enabled healthcare and data driven transformation

Responsibilities

  • Business Development 25 Proactively defining opportunities for business transformation operational improvement cost reduction and service optimization

  • Strategic Planning 25 Developing strategic recommendations business plans and actionable solutions for client challenges

  • Client Management 25 Engaging with employees and stakeholders leading workshops and presenting findings to executivelevel staff

  • Implementation Support 25 Planning and overseeing the execution of new systems processes or structural changes

Essential Skills

  • Work with clients to understand their needs define and assess possible strategies and identify new project ideas

  • Conduct assessments with healthcare clients to identify and prioritize areas of business improvement

  • Lead programme teams to design and deliver business solutions that meet the clients business goals and can be successfully implemented within the unique client environment

  • Build business cases for clients to support investment into business transformation programmes

  • Work closely with technologists to the map business needs to technology investments and design effective technical solutions

  • Support the development of roadmaps that guide clients through business transformation

  • Develop and deliver work output to C level executives

  • Design new approaches to monitor the effectiveness of solutions and demonstrate tangible business value

  • Ensure excellent communication and alignment with clients on project programme execution

  • Support business development activities including proposal development tender responses and ongoing client engagement

  • Assist in the development of service offerings that reflect client needs and present compelling solutions to the market

  • Help to analyze key healthcare market trends forces and identify new opportunities for services to the healthcare provider market

  • Provide coaching to junior graduate consultants and help them refine their skills and domain knowledge

  • Assist in the development of thought leadership pieces that will enhance our brand in the market

  • Maintain good communication with practice leadership and support collaboration sharing of ideas and best practices

Other

  • Travel to client sites may be needed estimated 1 day per week

  • Ability to grow accounts and develop new client relationships

  • Ability to work in a wide variety of client settings

  • Ability to work independently

  • Ability to balance client work with business development support

title: Storage & Backup Solutions Architect
description:
About the Role

As a Storage & Backup Solutions Architect, you will make an impact by designing and implementing robust storage and backup solutions across on-premises and cloud environments. You will be a valued member of the Infrastructure & Operations team, working collaboratively with platform leads, cloud architects, and service management teams to ensure data availability, protection, and resilience in line with agreed SLAs.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Design and implement enterprise storage solutions across on-prem and cloud environments, leveraging platforms such as NetApp, HPE, and Dell.

  • Own capacity planning activities, forecasting storage demand and ensuring infrastructure scales in line with business growth and project requirements.

  • Define and enforce backup policies, ensuring data protection standards are met across all environments and workloads.

  • Manage SLA adherence for storage and backup services, driving operational excellence and swift resolution of performance or availability issues.

  • Evaluate and implement backup tooling (e.g., Veeam or equivalent), overseeing deployment, configuration, and ongoing optimisation.

Work Model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring presence in a Cognizant or client office in the Netherlands on agreed days per week. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need to Have to Be Considered

  • 5+ years of experience with enterprise storage platforms, specifically NetApp, HPE, and/or Dell storage solutions.

  • Hands-on expertise with Veeam or comparable backup and recovery tooling in enterprise-scale environments.

  • Strong understanding of capacity planning methodologies and storage performance management.

  • Knowledge of ITIL frameworks, particularly in the context of change, incident, and problem management for storage services.

  • Experience designing backup policies and data protection strategies across hybrid (on-prem and cloud) environments.

These Will Help You Stand Out

  • Relevant certifications such as NetApp Certified Storage Associate (NCSA), Veeam VMCE, or equivalent.

  • Experience integrating storage solutions with cloud platforms (AWS S3, Azure Blob, or Google Cloud Storage) for tiered or hybrid storage architectures.

  • Familiarity with software-defined storage (SDS) solutions and converged/hyper-converged infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of data governance and regulatory compliance requirements related to data retention and backup.

  • Strong knowledge of database migration tooling such as Oracle GoldenGate, Data Pump, or equivalent migration frameworks.

  • Demonstrated experience in performance tuning at the database, SQL, and instance level.

title: Data Center Security Architect
description:
About the Role

As a Data Center Security Architect, you will make an impact by designing and developing end-to-end physical and logical security architecture for data centre environments. You will be a valued member of the Critical Infrastructure & Facility Design team, working collaboratively with facility engineers, compliance officers, and technology leads to build secure, sustainable, and regulation-compliant data centre solutions that set the standard for operational resilience.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Design and develop end-to-end DC physical and logical security architecture, integrating advanced access controls, surveillance systems, and anti-tampering measures to protect critical infrastructure.

  • Optimize structural, power, and cooling systems within data centre facility designs, aligning solutions with green data centre standards and global energy efficiency benchmarks.

  • Ensure all architectural models and construction documents strictly comply with applicable regulatory frameworks, building codes, and safety regulations.

  • Conduct security risk assessments across facility and infrastructure layers, identifying vulnerabilities and prescribing mitigation strategies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including operations, compliance, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements throughout the data centre lifecycle, from design through to commissioning.

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible.   • Familiarity with green data centre standards and energy efficiency frameworks such as PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness), ISO 50001, or equivalent.

  • Deep understanding of regulatory compliance, including relevant building codes, safety regulations, and data centre certification standards (e.g., Uptime Institute Tier, EN 50600).
